def _branch_feature(attribute: dict, evidence: list[dict]) -> dict:
    status = _attribute_status(attribute, evidence)
    value = max(attribute["value"] - 1, 0) if status == "OBSERVED" else None
    parameters = POLICY["additional_branches"]
    return {
        "status": status,
        "observed_branch_count": attribute["value"],
        "value": value,
        **parameters,
        "contribution": min(value, parameters["cap"]) * parameters["weight"]
        if value is not None
        else 0,
        "rule": POLICY["baseline_rule"],
        "evidence": evidence,
    }

def test_conflicting_branches_remain_unscored_even_after_confirmation(small_ledger):
    small_ledger += [
        observation("TEST-B1", "CO-A", "branch_count", 2),
        observation("TEST-B2", "CO-A", "branch_count", 3, status="CONFIRMED", cut="T1"),
    ]
    assert company(compare_rankings(small_ledger, "T0"))["baseline_score"] == 10
    result = company(compare_rankings(small_ledger, "T1"))
    feature = result["features"]["additional_branches"]
    assert result["baseline_score"] == 0
    assert feature["status"] == "CONFLICTED" and feature["value"] is None
    assert [row["value"] for row in feature["evidence"]] == [2, 3]

def compare_rankings(rows: list[dict], as_of: str | datetime) -> dict:
    """Calcular ambas políticas sobre la misma cohorte, sin red, escrituras ni etiquetas."""
    view = snapshot(rows, as_of)
    observations = view["observations"]
    claims = _relationship_context(view["relationships"])
    companies, excluded = [], []
    for company in view["companies"]:
        company_id, attributes = company["company_id"], company["attributes"]
        evidence = defaultdict(list)
        for row in observations:
            if row["subject_type"] == "COMPANY" and row["subject_id"] == company_id:
                evidence[row["attribute"]].append(row)
        service = attributes["service_active"]
        service_evidence = evidence["service_active"]
        service_status = _attribute_status(service, service_evidence)
        active = (
            service_status == "OBSERVED"
            and service["value"] is True
            and {row["verification_status"] for row in _latest(service_evidence)} == {"CONFIRMED"}
        )
        result = {
            "company_id": company_id,
            "display_name": attributes["display_name"]["value"],
            "name_evidence": evidence["display_name"],
            "identity_status": company["identity_status"],
            "eligibility": {
                "eligible": not active,
                "status": "ACTIVE_SERVICE_CONFIRMED" if active else "PENDING_COMMERCIAL_VALIDATION",
                "service_status": service_status,
                "observed_service_active": service["value"],
                "evidence": service_evidence,
            },
        }
        if active:
            excluded.append(result)
            continue
        branches = _branch_feature(attributes["branch_count"], evidence["branch_count"])
        neighbors = _neighbor_feature(company_id, claims)
        result.update(
            {
                "features": {"additional_branches": branches, "confirmed_neighbors": neighbors},
                "baseline_score": branches["contribution"],
                "graph_score": branches["contribution"] + neighbors["contribution"],
            }
        )
        companies.append(result)
    baseline = sorted(companies, key=lambda row: (-row["baseline_score"], row["company_id"]))
    graph = sorted(companies, key=lambda row: (-row["graph_score"], row["company_id"]))
    capacity = POLICY["capacity"]
    for policy, ordered in (("baseline", baseline), ("graph", graph)):
        for position, company in enumerate(ordered, start=1):
            company[f"{policy}_position"] = position
            company[f"{policy}_selected"] = position <= capacity
    for company in baseline:
        company["position_change"] = company["baseline_position"] - company["graph_position"]
        company["selection_change"] = (
            "BOTH"
            if company["baseline_selected"] and company["graph_selected"]
            else "GRAPH_ONLY"
            if company["graph_selected"]
            else "BASELINE_ONLY"
            if company["baseline_selected"]
            else "NEITHER"
        )
    baseline_ids = [row["company_id"] for row in baseline[:capacity]]
    graph_ids = [row["company_id"] for row in graph[:capacity]]
    canonical = json.dumps(observations, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    return {
        "policy": deepcopy(POLICY),
        "as_of": view["as_of"],
        "visible_input_sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
        "known_companies": len(view["companies"]),
        "eligible_companies": len(companies),
        "visible_observations": len(observations),
        "companies": baseline,
        "excluded": excluded,
        "top_k": {"baseline": baseline_ids, "graph": graph_ids},
        "comparison": {
            "shared": sorted(set(baseline_ids) & set(graph_ids)),
            "entered_graph": [key for key in graph_ids if key not in baseline_ids],
            "left_baseline": [key for key in baseline_ids if key not in graph_ids],
            "baseline_boundary": _boundary(baseline, "baseline_score"),
            "graph_boundary": _boundary(graph, "graph_score"),
            "unfilled_capacity": max(capacity - len(companies), 0),
        },
        "relationship_context": claims,
        "identity_candidates": view["identities"],
        "conflicts": view["conflicts"],
    }

def test_focused_network_only_highlights_approved_feature_evidence(public_rows, cut):
    context = tower.build_context(public_rows, cut)
    before = deepcopy(context)
    cafe = next(
        row for row in context["ranking"]["companies"] if row["display_name"] == "Café Jacaranda"
    )
    key = cafe["company_id"]
    network = tower.network_data(context, {key}, focus_id=key)
    center = next(node for node in network["nodes"] if node["id"] == key)
    assert (center["x"], center["y"]) == (0, 0)
    expected = {
        identifier
        for neighbor in cafe["features"]["confirmed_neighbors"]["neighbors"]
        for identifier in neighbor["relationship_ids"]
    }
    assert {edge["id"] for edge in network["edges"] if edge["supports_focus"]} == expected
    assert all(
        edge["scoring_status"] == "CONFIRMED" for edge in network["edges"] if edge["supports_focus"]
    )
    assert all(
        not edge["supports_focus"]
        for edge in network["edges"]
        if edge["type"] == tower.TYPES["REFERS_TO"]
    )
    assert len({(node["x"], node["y"]) for node in network["nodes"]}) == len(network["nodes"])
    assert context == before
    assert_no_private_fields(network)

def _evaluate(scenario: dict, settings: dict, pools: int) -> dict:
    pools = _positive_integer(pools, "pools")
    slots = pools * settings["capacity_per_pool"]
    p, delta = scenario["baseline_activation_rate"], scenario["activation_rate_increment"]
    margin = scenario["contract_margin_per_activation"]
    commercial_base = slots * scenario["baseline_commercial_cost_per_slot"]
    commercial_graph = commercial_base + slots * scenario["incremental_commercial_cost_per_slot"]
    fixed, operating = scenario["fixed_incremental_cost"], scenario["operating_incremental_cost"]
    commercial_delta = commercial_graph - commercial_base
    unselected = scenario["unselected_margin_increment"]
    selected_delta = slots * delta * margin
    net = selected_delta - commercial_delta + unselected - fixed - operating
    reserve = settings["reserve_rate"] * (fixed + operating)
    threshold_cost = commercial_delta + fixed + operating - unselected
    return {
        "scenario": scenario["name"],
        "pools": pools,
        "capacity_per_pool": 5,
        "slots": slots,
        "baseline_activation_rate": p,
        "graph_activation_rate": p + delta,
        "activation_rate_increment": delta,

def ranking_table(context: dict, ids: set | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    """Copiar puntuaciones/posiciones globales; nunca rellenar el top-5 del segmento."""
    return [
        {
            "ID": row["company_id"],
            "Empresa": row["display_name"] or row["company_id"],
            "Posición baseline": row["baseline_position"],
            "Posición grafo": row["graph_position"],
            "Cambio de posición": row["position_change"],
            "Score baseline": row["baseline_score"],
            "Score grafo": row["graph_score"],
            "Aporte individual": row["features"]["additional_branches"]["contribution"],
            "Aporte relacional": row["features"]["confirmed_neighbors"]["contribution"],
            "Top-5 baseline": row["baseline_selected"],
            "Top-5 grafo": row["graph_selected"],
        }
        for row in context["ranking"]["companies"]
        if ids is None or row["company_id"] in ids
    ]

def test_industry_filters_do_not_refill_funnel_or_rankings(public_rows):
    context = tower.build_context(public_rows, "T2")
    ids = tower.segment_ids(context, industry=tower.UNKNOWN)
    assert len(ids) == 10
    rows = tower.funnel(context, ids, "graph")
    eligible = {c["company_id"] for c in context["ranking"]["companies"]}
    assert rows[0]["Cantidad"] == rows[1]["Cantidad"] + rows[2]["Cantidad"]
    assert rows[1]["Cantidad"] == len(ids & eligible)
    assert rows[3]["Cantidad"] == len(ids & set(context["ranking"]["top_k"]["graph"]))
    assert all(row["Cantidad"] is None and row["Estado"] == "No observado" for row in rows[4:])
    assert tower.ranking_table(context, ids) == [
        row for row in tower.ranking_table(context) if row["ID"] in ids
    ]
    assert tower.segment_ids(context, industry="Sector inexistente") == set()
